pr_metadata.title: fix(rust): drop unused-allowed-license from the packaged deny.toml
pr_metadata.summary: Removes the unused-allowed-license = "allow" setting and its comment from the packaged rust deny.toml, so cargo-deny's default applies again and allowed-but-unused licenses produce a warning rather than being silenced, per the human's ruling on epic .github#1091 Task 3.
pr_metadata.notes:
Merge review: done: eligible; accepted-risk 0

Three-line deletion in src/vergil_tooling/configs/rust/deny.toml; the rest of the policy is unchanged. The setting was added by #4347 but is not called for by plan Task 3. No test or doc referenced it. The restored default warns and does not fail cargo deny check.
